mcq.question: Which pattern lets undo restore a deleted line?

options.C: Command, because the delete object remembers the line it removed

mcq.explanation: Each command keeps the state it needs to reverse itself, and a history stack replays undo in reverse order.

mcq.question: Why do the decorators take a `std::unique_ptr<Exporter>`?

options.A: Decorators must be allocated on the heap
options.B: The decorator owns the exporter it wraps, so stacks are freed automatically
options.D: It stops two decorators being stacked

mcq.explanation: Each layer owns the next one. Destroying the outer decorator destroys the whole chain.
